content: Tags vs categories: the category norm is a hierarchical category system (Money Manager supports optional sub-categories; YNAB has category groups; Spendee/Bluecoins custom categories), NOT tags. Tags exist in a few apps (e.g. Money Manager labels) but categories remain the primary classification dimension. The project's single-level per-type categories with no tags matches the mainstream; tags are a power-user extra, safe to exclude.
